title: 15 years of ‘almost no progress’ in getting young people moving: WHO

refs.t: 15 years of ‘almost no progress’ in getting young people moving: WHO
refs.p: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

sum: The World Health Organization (WHO) released new global estimates showing that one in four adolescents worldwide reported not getting at least 60 minutes of physical activity on any day in the previous week. This is considered "almost no progress" in getting young people moving.
description: One in four adolescents worldwide reported not getting at least 60 minutes of physical activity on any day in the previous week, according to new global estimates released by the World Health Organization (WHO) on Wednesday.
